title: Recycle Gas Compressor Pre-Start Lube Priming Procedure
content: ONE POINT LESSON: OPL-KC-4501-01. Title: Recycle Gas Compressor Pre-Start Lube Priming Procedure. Equipment: KC-4501. Area: 4500. Interlock Ref: SEQ-4501. PURPOSE: Ensure crosshead, crankpin, and piston rod packings receive adequate lube pressure prior to compressor start. SAFETY: Flammable gas zone, wear ESD PPE. PROCEDURE: Step 1: Start auxiliary lube oil pump. Step 2: Verify lube pressure on PI-4504 reaches 2.5 barg. Step 3: Check cylinder pre-lube lubricator drops (12 drops/min). Step 4: Confirm zero active trip on SEQ-4501. TROUBLESHOOTING: Low lube pressure -> check suction strainer or gear pump wear.
